TYPES.FINDING_ID: valid non-empty NFC string without leading/trailing Unicode whitespace
TYPES.OBSERVED_BLOB_SHA: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA or absent

LOCATORS.NOTE: Observed blob is audit evidence only. Manifest generation MUST resolve the definition path and actual blob from its pinned control snapshot.

ORDERING: LOCATORS sorted by FINDING_ID UTF-8 bytes then DEFINITION_PATH UTF-8 bytes
VALIDATION: At the pinned snapshot, definition path exists and media type equals EXPECTED_MEDIA_TYPE.
Parsed definition FINDING_ID equals locator FINDING_ID exactly.
A locator never supplies or overrides TYPE, SEVERITY, STATUS, control relevance, or terminal semantics.
Observed blob mismatch is not itself an error when the pinned snapshot changed; resolution always uses the pinned snapshot blob.
Any duplicate locator identity/path or resolution mismatch makes the consuming universe manifest incomplete.
